Sept
14

Peter Mackay: Messing with words: a poetry workshop

  • Monday 14 September 2026
  • 15:00 17:00
  • An Tobar Snug (map)
  • Google Calendar ICS

Writing doesn’t have to be ‘strange loneliness’ - in Seamus Heaney’s words – but can also involves poets working together, or in response to each other, between languages or within the same language, to share that loneliness, or make it strange together. In this workshop we will explore different kinds of poetic non-aloneness, and ways of creating with other people (or indeed creating at entirely cross-purposes with someone else). Bring with you: a couple of words that have particular resonance for you (as words from your family, from a private language, from a love relationship) that you won’t mind sharing.

Royal Zoological Society of Scotland presents: Clinging By A Claw

  • Thursday 20 August 2026
  • 19:30 20:30
  • An Tobar (map)
  • Google Calendar ICS

Clinging by a Claw, created by Saving Wildcats and produced by SCOTLAND: The Big Picture, offers an extraordinary insight into the journey of Scotland's wildcats from the brink of extinction to their return to the wilds of the Cairngorms National Park.

Narrated by Outlander star Sam Heughan, this film captures the breathtakingly beautiful landscapes of the Scottish Highlands where wildcats could have a future if they continue to receive the vital support they need.

Jul
28

Invasive Species

  • Tuesday 28 July 2026
  • 15:00 19:00
  • An Tobar (map)
  • Google Calendar ICS

Invasive Species, featuring Spectrum of Belonging

Step off the beaten track and into a different way of seeing Mull.

This free audio walk through Aros Park combines sound, storytelling and contemporary visual art in an immersive journey through the island’s layered ecological history. Collect your equipment from An Tobar and follow a self-guided route through woodland, shoreline and hidden corners of the park, encountering sculptural installations, environmental soundscapes and stories spanning thousands of years.

Created by Fast Familiar with Play:Vienna and An Tobar and Mull Theatre, and featuring the striking installation Spectrum of Belonging by Surface Agency, Invasive Species explores what it means to belong within a changing landscape shaped by migration, tourism, climate and human intervention.

Launching 28 July 2026.

Free to access during week-day opening hours.
